marker.comment: The wordmark close-up ends before the line under it comes up; in the tail handle a misspelled version of it (HEALTHY HEATH) is in plain view.
marker.name: Keep the tail

marker.comment: The head handle shows a pad worker in the foreground (seen from behind). The film starts after they are gone.
marker.name: Keep the head

marker.comment: The head handle shows a pad worker in an orange suit beside the rocket (seen from behind). The film starts after the camera clears them.
marker.name: Keep the head

marker.comment: Zoomed 1.28 from the top and shifted down 118 px, so a truck lettered with a generated copy of The Flavor Factory logo (bottom left) sits under the letterbox. Keep the framing.
marker.name: Framing hides a generated logo

marker.comment: The same truck as on the face-off, kept under the letterbox the same way (zoom 1.28 from the top, down 118 px).
marker.name: Framing hides a generated logo

marker.comment: Zoomed 1.13 from the top and shifted down 118 px, so the generated line under the wordmark (it reads HEALTHY HOUTH) sits under the letterbox.
marker.name: Framing hides a misspelled line

marker.comment: The misspelled line under the wordmark is blurred in place (four soft regions, baked into the shot at fixed positions). In the handles the bottle drifts, so check the line stays covered if you extend it.
marker.name: Softened in place

marker.comment: The beaker carries generated print (a logo, a nonsense word, wrong graduations); it is blurred in place.
marker.name: Softened in place

marker.comment: Zoomed 1.07 from the top and shifted down 118 px, so a garbled TheraBreath name on the front of the box sits under the letterbox. The badge at the top right is blurred in place.
marker.name: Framing hides a mangled name

marker.comment: The misspelled line beside the wordmark is blurred in place.
marker.name: Softened in place

marker.comment: From 23.3 s into the source the flag shows a garbled wordmark and the camera pulls back; the shot ends at 23.25 s, so do not extend the tail. A sticker on the latch is blurred in place.
marker.name: Ends before the flag opens

marker.comment: The flag wide, the lift-off and the late rival are the V12 shots, cooled and desaturated to match the new grey regolith. The flag wide plays at 0.26x.
marker.name: V12 Moon shots, graded to match

marker.comment: The score cuts on the cut to the Moon and returns on the flag wide. The effects stem carries the descent and the landing.
marker.name: Music is silent here

marker.comment: The edge of space: the score stops here and comes back on the downbeat of the race.
marker.name: Music is silent here

marker.comment: The misspelled line under the wordmark is blurred in place. About 0.2 s past the out-point the rival flies into frame beside TheraBreath, which the story rules out (it is still on the Moon): do not extend the tail.
marker.name: Softened in place; keep the tail

marker.comment: The generated product bottle carries garbled print and a fake organic seal; both are blurred in place (the seal harder). The score has faded by +3.0 s; the sixth sample is set down at +4.05 s in the quiet.
marker.name: Product bottle softened

marker.comment: Shortly after the out-point the bottle comes into focus with its garbled print, and the source ends on a generated title card. Do not extend the tail.
marker.name: Keep the tail
